stemMarkdown: A thief driving at 40 km/h gets a head start of 2 hours. A police car then sets off along the same road at 60 km/h. How many hours does the police car take to catch the thief? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In 2 hours the thief covers $40 \times 2 = 80$ km. The police close that gap at $60 - 40 = 20$ km/h, taking $\dfrac{80}{20} = 4.0$ hours.
